ideas.title: Aggressive local quants need repetition-loop tests before they touch document pipelines
ideas.connection: Unsloth's 1-bit quant claims 91% top-1 retention, but that check does not measure repetition loops, and Boo Bench's 179 loop-triggering pages plus llama.cpp's fixed reasoning budget make a cheap, predictable loop test for local runs.

ideas.title: Inference buyers should rerun hardware bake-offs now, because kernels swing cost per token
ideas.connection: AMD's 2x per-dollar claim depends on AITER tuning, vLLM v0.33.0 final ships a gfx950 AITER fix, and agent-written Hopper kernels add up to 38% decode speed, so software now moves the hardware ranking.

ideas.title: Platform teams can gate every agent skill install behind a scan this quarter
ideas.connection: The Cursor Marketplace backdoor shows agent add-ons are a live supply chain risk, npx skills gives one install path to control, and SkillSpector can scan skills for injection and exfiltration before that path lets them through.

ideas.title: Teams shipping HTML previews can have a repo agent file sandbox-hole issues
ideas.connection: The ChatGPT exploit gives a concrete pattern to hunt for, the Cloudflare skill is a widely adopted agent-run security audit, and DeepSeek's proactive agent works a repo through issues and PRs without waiting for a prompt.

ideas.title: Consultants can sell local model hallucination audits including new diffusion models
ideas.connection: AA-Omniscience now has a 300-question public set calibrated to its private set with the same Net Score scoring, and llama-swap puts Clover 35B A3B and an autoregressive Qwen model behind one endpoint so both can be scored in one run.

ideas.title: Repo agents can file only security issues they proved in a sandbox
ideas.connection: On 2026-11-01 Magpie suggested a proactive repo agent could file sandbox-hole issues using the audit skill; today's OpenRouter reviewer pattern confirms bugs in a Linux sandbox and returns validated patches, which targets the idea's main risk of noisy actions maintainers must revert.

builds_on.title: Teams shipping HTML previews can have a repo agent file sandbox-hole issues

ideas.title: Security consultancies can sell long unattended code audits with self-verified findings
ideas.connection: Gemini 4 Carbon claims state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon ability, and VeriHarness checks long agent outputs by comparing attempts with no gold answer, which is the normal state of a client audit.

ideas.title: IT teams must audit local agent tool calls now that installs take one click
ideas.connection: Cline Desktop makes local open-weight coding agents easy to install, the Qwen3.8 incident shows such a model can call a tool after saying it would not, and Copilot's assisted permissions show what a command and file-path gate looks like.

ideas.title: Accounting firms can automate legacy desktop entry while client data stays internal
ideas.connection: GPT-6.1 Terra is pitched as fast, broadly available computer use, the secure tunnel lets an OpenAI agent reach private MCP servers without a public endpoint, and Headroom shrinks the tool output that each step sends to the model.

ideas.title: Law firms can triage locally and wake a large private model only when needed
ideas.connection: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash now runs in about 150 GB RAM, Ollama's local decision models can classify and route requests, and llama-swap switches between local servers behind one endpoint.
